media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual sources relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, including directory evidence and German film-periodical materials.
media.rightsNote: Rights are stated on each item in this gallery, not on the gallery as a whole. It gathers documents under different terms: some are public domain or served under the reuse terms of the holding institution, and 4 are reproduced at reduced resolution with rights uncleared. Follow the item to read its own statement.
media.publicCreditLine: Credits are given on each item. The gallery gathers material from the Deutsches Zeitungsportal of the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek, ANNO of the Österreichische Nationalbibliothek, Polona of the Biblioteka Narodowa, the ZLB digital collections and the Internet Archive.
